200 tinh huong TIENG ANH — 100 lua dao, 100 lanh. Dung 20/8/2026.

VI SAO CAN BO NAY: pack tieng Viet co bo 100 va len duoc 79% nho do lien tuc.
Pack tieng Anh chua tung duoc do lan nao — hai lo hong tim thay hom nay deu lo
ra do nguoi dung tinh co go mot cau, khong phai do co ai di tim.

TRON HAI LOI VIET, VA DO LA DIEM CHINH:
  · 'dan nguyen tin' — loi cua ke lua:  'This is Officer Daniels...'
  · 'ke lai'         — loi cua bac:     'A man said he was from the police...'
Pack tieng Anh truoc nay chi duoc thu o loi thu nhat. Nguoi dung that go theo
loi thu hai, va do 20/8/2026 cho thay loi do truot gan het.

NUA LANH CO Y VIET KHO: 68% mang so tien, chu 'urgent/today', ten ngan hang,
duong link, chu 'police', chu 'code'. Tin lanh hien lanh thi ti le bao oan 0%
khong chung minh duoc gi. Khac biet duy nhat: chung KHONG doi bac lam gi nguy hiem.

CHAM DIEM: mot ca lua dao tinh la BAT DUOC khi muc >= NGHI_NGO. `mongDoi` chi la
ghi chu, khong phai dieu kien — hai loai sai khong cung gia (§4.6).
